doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Shade's instruments including the streamlined bass
summary: Shade plays guitar, harmonica, jug and a one-string cane 'streamlined bass', which he has played ten or fifteen years.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Let me ask Son a question. Son, what instruments do you play? We forgot that.
I play guitar, harmonica, jug, and bass, streamlined bass.
That's the cane that I play on, one string.
Like a washtub, in other words.
How long you been playing that?
I've been playing that for about 10 or 15 years.
